decision.summary: A multi-axis upward offset initiates sharply near index 442 (aligned with numerical jump candidate), affecting N, E, and U. While N and E show a slight relaxation after ~445, none of the three components fully returns to pre-event levels within the allowed context (400–480). The absence of a clear opposing return on any axis prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; thus, only one uncertain interval is reported.

intervals.observation: N/E/U all show a sharp upward step near index 442 (consistent with candidate jump at 442), followed by sustained elevated levels. N and E exhibit a modest partial decline starting ~445–446 but do not return to pre-step baseline by 479; U remains clearly elevated with no return observed. Return is unobserved/ambiguous across axes, so status is uncertain.
